title: The Shinri Game 2: Magical Trip - In-game BGM 9
description:
A long, repetitive and atmospheric song from The Shinri Game 2. Good for caves or abstract stages.

Only use this song in levels with no time limit, if the time limit goes below 100 it causes the drum loop to desync
